Subject: Quick recap & next steps — evidence & retention (Meridian Pay)

Hi Sanjay — thanks again for the time today. Short recap of what we heard, the gaps you called out, and proposed owners/timelines so we can keep procurement moving. Please flag anything I missed.

Summary of pain points / objectives you shared:
- SOC 2 Type II as a gating item for procurement (controls evidence + redacted report)
- Audit log retention: Meridian needs a minimum of 12 months of immutable audit logs; Redwood default retention is 90d for hosted logs
- DPA terms: data residency (US), subprocessors list, and required indemnity/SLAs
- Pen test evidence: historical reports and scope; you want to confirm Redwood’s testing cadence and whether we support customer-directed pen tests

Agreed next steps (owners + dates):
1) Marcus: provide a concrete artifact checklist and suggested export formats by 2026-01-16 (attachment: requested-artifact-list.xlsx).
2) Laura: confirm technical options for extending audit log retention (export, longer hot retention, or archive) + estimated cost impact by 2026-01-18.
3) Neha: share where we store SOC 2 documents and the redaction process; confirm timeline to provide a redacted Type II if allowable by our legal constraints by 2026-01-21.
4) Meridian: share any locked-down scope for pen tests and the security questionnaire (you mentioned a .docx) — target by 2026-01-15.

High-level trade-offs we discussed:
- Longer audit retention can be implemented via cold archive exports; there’s an ops cost and egress consideration if you need frequent access.
- Full SOC 2 report can be shared redacted; we will work with legal on what is permissible.

I attached a short artifact checklist to make intake easier. Planning to follow up with a technical note from Laura on the retention options. If it's helpful, we can set a 30-minute follow-up next week to walk through the artifact list with your security team.

Best,
Marcus Lin

Marcus — thanks, this is helpful and captures the call. Quick clarifications from our side and a couple of additional asks: 

Clarifications / extra asks:
- SOC 2: we need a redacted Type II if possible; if not, a point-in-time control attestation plus an inventory of controls and evidence locations will suffice for procurement.
- Retention: 12 months minimum for audit logs; immutable/append-only preferred (we can accept signed timestamps or WORM in archive).
- Pen test evidence: please provide your most recent external penetration test summary and the statement of scope. We will likely run a customer-directed pen test later in the cycle and need to understand the coordination model.
- KMS/HSM: we need a short write-up on key management and whether Redwood supports customer-managed keys (CMKs) or HSM integrations.
- Subprocessors: full list + notification policy.
- SLA credits: if we require explicit uptime/latency SLOs for payment flows, we may ask for a commercial SLA or credit language in the contract.

Procurement timeline: target to complete security review and legal by 2026-02-05.

Hi all — following up with concrete technical options and what we can deliver on the timelines above. Marcus: attaching the pen test summary we have that aligns with Sanjay's ask (meridian-pen-test-summary.pdf).

Audit log retention options (pros/cons):
1) Extended hot retention (hosted): increase the retention window from 90d -> 365d. Pros: fast access and no export needed. Cons: higher storage costs and longer hot-index maintenance. Estimated incremental cost: ~$0.0025/token-day (we'll give a line item for procurement).
2) Cold archive exports: daily exports to customer-owned blob (AWS S3/GS): archived as gzip CSV or Parquet with SHA256 checksums and object immutability flags. Pros: lowest ongoing cost; supports WORM via bucket policies. Cons: retrieval requires restore time + egress.
3) Hybrid: 90d hot + rolling monthly archive for the prior 9 months (gives quicker access for recent events).

What we will deliver by 2026-01-21:
- Sample audit-log export (CSV) with schema and a short README on export cadence and checksum verification (owner: Laura).
- Pen-test summary + statement of scope (attached): meridian-pen-test-summary.pdf (owner: Laura).
- Short KMS/HSM note: Redwood supports customer-managed keys via our KMS integration (we can bind a CMK via the Private offering) — full HSM-backed flows require Dedicated or Private deployment. Neha will follow up with a product note on the CMK flows.

Neha/Legal notes:
- SOC 2: we can provide a redacted Type II report for procurement; legal will confirm the exact redaction level.
- Subprocessors: we can provide an exportable subprocessors list and our notification cadence.

Next suggested activity: 30-min intake with Priya to walk the artifact checklist and confirm formats. Proposed time: 2026-01-20 10:00 AM PT. Marcus — can you confirm?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
